name: Somna
subtitle: Every night tells a story.
description: A nightly journal for iPhone. Somna listens while you sleep and builds a timeline of what it heard, with the audio behind every event so you can check it yourself. Everything stays on your device. Somna is not a medical device.

apps.name: Somna
apps.subtitle: Every night tells a story.
apps.localizedDescription:
Somna records the sounds of your night and turns them into a timeline you can read in the morning.

Every detection keeps its audio, so you can listen and decide for yourself whether Somna got it right. Detections are worded by confidence: "cough detected", "likely cough", or "cough-like sound".

Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no server, nothing uploaded, and speech is never transcribed.

Somna is not a medical device. It does not diagnose anything, does not detect sleep apnea, and does not measure sleep stages.

Public beta. Expect rough edges, and please report them.
